metric_contract.swing_aggression: 100 * mean(actual swing indicator - selected OOF expected swing probability); percentage points
metric_contract.za_raw: 100 * mean(actual zone-aligned judgment - league expected judgment); percentage points
metric_contract.za_percentile: empirical percentile of ZA Raw among hitters with at least 300 pitches
metric_contract.raw_dv: sum of per-pitch Decision Value across all eligible pitches; cumulative runs and primary DV display
metric_contract.dv_per_100: 100 * mean((V_Swing - V_Take) for swings; sign reversed for takes); runs per 100 pitches
